body:
Thank you all for attending the meeting today and a special thank you to Domenic for taking meeting notes! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10734):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Domenic, Mike, Mu-An, Olli, Yoav  
Scribe: Domenic

1. Review past action items
    1.  Anne will check with Ryosuke on his concern in [Atomic move operation for element reparenting & reordering](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/1255).
        1. Keep carrying this over.
        1. There was some discussion on the WHATWG Matrix about focus behavior, at least.
    1. Di will add an example with a shadowdom and update the spec for [tabindex vs reading-flow property](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10642).
        1. Di added the [example](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10642#issuecomment-2436320362).
    1. Olli will discuss [Add expect-no-linked-resources Document-Policy to Speculative parsing](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10718) with Henri. Mason will ask Alex to come to a future meeting to give us more context.
        1. Alex will join us at the November 7 meeting to discuss this.
        1. [smaug] Asked, and hsivonen agreed that it would be rather useless in Gecko
        1. Some discussion in the minutes.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. Khushal will incorporate the feedback to the [Canvas Place Element](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10650) explainer.
        1. [smaug] looks like it hasn't been updated
        1. Let's keep carrying this over!
    1.  Joey to ping Chromium folks for [[images] Lazy loading and out of band loads](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10671)
        1. Let's keep carrying this over until something gets resolved
        1. [smaug] This is a web-compat issue so it'd be nice to give it higher priority
        1. Domenic will ping Dom Farolino in case he has context
1. New topics
    1. [Yoav] [Multiple import maps](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10528)
        1. [smaug] pinged the right folks at Mozilla
            1. No updates yet

### Action Items

1.  @domenic will ping Dom Farolino in case he has context around [[images] Lazy loading and out of band loads](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10671).

### Minutes

(Didn't keep detailed minutes of most topics, instead preferring to note updates in-line above.)

**Discussion of expect-no-linked-resources**

Domenic: any thoughts on whether people oppose adding these sorts of Document-Policy "doesn't hurt if not implemented" features?

Olli: it makes the platform more complicated.

(some discussion about how there's no benefit in Gecko. Probably some benefit in WebKit.)

Domenic: very reasonable for Gecko not to support this, but I hope they wouldn't strongly object.

Olli: looking forward to hearing more from Alex.
